error_message: Earlier Google Drive attempts rejected a local generated-file path/reference for connector egress.
public_page_impact: Recovered successfully. The exact preserved original is now published and live verified; no unrelated page or sports-data changes were made.
recovery_action: Used the runtime-generated file reference returned with the original image rather than treating its mounted filesystem path as the connector file object. Google Drive accepted that exact original and created the durable master. The master was fetched back through the supported connector, hash/bytes/dimensions were preserved, inserted into a temporary native Doc, and its exact sourceUri was submitted to the existing reusable uploader. Upload and fcb-wnba live verification both succeeded. No hostname rewriting, URL guessing, recompression, downsampling, permission change or paid service was used.
notes: The root cause was use of the wrong file-reference form for Drive upload, not an expired Google OAuth connection. The connected Drive profile remained valid throughout. Future generated-image preservation should prefer the runtime file ID/reference supplied with the generation result, then verify the stored master before publication.
